description: Mute one of NewsJack’s built-in publications so its Stories stop appearing in this account’s feed. Identify it by its exact publication name. For a custom RSS feed the account added itself, use toggle_source with its source_id instead. Reversible with enable_global_source and idempotent.

source_name.description: Exact name of the global source, e.g. 'Music Business Worldwide'.

name: disable_global_source
